question.text: The Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation (DICGC) insures each depositor across all branches of a given bank up to a maximum of:

explanation.text: The Logic: DICGC insures deposits up to Rs. 5 lakh per depositor per bank, including all deposits and the interest on them held across all branches of that bank. The Trap: Rs. 1 lakh, Rs. 2 lakh and Rs. 10 lakh are not the current limit — the prescribed coverage is Rs. 5 lakh. Note: The limit is applied per depositor per bank, aggregating deposits and interest across that bank's branches.
